rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for flicking or tapping something with a quick finger motion.

example.english: Flick the switch once, and the TV will come on.
example.traditional: 彈一下個掣，部電視就開喇。
example.jyutping: daan6 jat1 haa5 go3 zai3 bou6 din6 si6 zau6 hoi1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when flicking or brushing something aside, especially hair, dust, or a loose object.

example.english: Flick the hair away from your forehead so you can see more clearly.
example.traditional: 撥開額前啲頭髮，睇清楚啲。
example.jyutping: but6 hoi1 ngaak6 cin4 di1 tau4 faat3 tai2 cing1 co2 di1

rows.note: Use this when someone or something passes so quickly that it is only briefly or unclearly perceived.

example.english: I only saw the bus flick past in front of me.
example.traditional: 我淨係見到架巴士喺眼前一閃而過。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 gin3 dou2 gaa3 baa1 si2 hai2 ngaan5 cin4 jat1 sim2 ji4 gwo3
